rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Address
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A postal or physical address related to an organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: P2P Organization
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An organization as defined in the Purchase-to-Pay Ontology (P2P-O), subclass of Organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Summary Section
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The section of the invoice summarizing totals such as tax and invoice amount.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: is message contained in
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Inverse property of containsMessage.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: quantity value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The quantity value for a line item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Message
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A business message such as INVOIC, contained within an InterchangeEnvelope.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: price value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The net price value for a line item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: invoice amount value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The value of the total invoice amount.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Invoice Line Item Detail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A pivot class reifying the relationship between a line item, its price, and quantity for the invoice detail section.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Tax Amount
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The total tax amount for the invoice.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: address line
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A line of text in an address.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Reference Number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference number such as an invoice number.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Buyer Role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specific agent role indicating the organization is acting as buyer.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Document Date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A date associated with the invoice document (issue, due, etc.).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Line Item
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An item listed on the invoice, representing goods or services sold.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: contains message
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Relates an InterchangeEnvelope to its contained Message(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: document date value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The value of a document date (in string format).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Warehouse Address
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The address of an organizations warehouse.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: tax amount value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The value of the tax amount.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: P2P Item
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An item as defined in the Purchase-to-Pay Ontology (P2P-O), subclass of LineItem.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Global Location Number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A globally unique location identifier for organizations.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Interchange Envelope
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The outermost envelope containing one or more EDIFACT messages.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Composite Data Element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A composite data element within a segment, grouping multiple simple elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Simple Data Element
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A basic data element within a composite or segment, representing atomic values.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Price
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The net price of a line item on the invoice.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: role identifier
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The identifier for a specific agent role (e.g. code for Buyer or DeliveryParty).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Headquarters Address
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The main address of an organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Agent Role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A role played by an organization in the context of an invoice (e.g., Buyer, DeliveryParty).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Organization Role Assignment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A pivot class reifying the assignment of a role to an organization.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Invoice
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An invoice document represented in the EDIFACT INVOIC message format.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: location number
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The identifier value of a GlobalLocationNumber.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Quantity
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The number of units for a line item on the invoice.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: EDIFACT Invoice Ontology
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Ontology for modeling the structure and semantics of EDIFACT invoice messages (D96A) including envelopes, messages, segments, organizations, roles, and line items.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reference number value
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The value of a reference number (e.g., invoice number).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Header Section
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The section of the invoice containing general document information (dates, references).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Invoice Amount
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The total amount of the invoice.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Segment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A segment within a message, such as BGM or NAD, composed of composite and simple data elements.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Business Process
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A business process to which the invoice can be assigned.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Delivery Party Role
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A specific agent role indicating the organization is acting as delivery party.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Detail Section
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The section of the invoice listing line items and their details.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Organization
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A party involved in the invoice, such as buyer, supplier, or delivery party.
